details:
I got a feeling that VRChat needs more self-moderation tools I would Love to have a permission system I would like to be able to set people too moderator allow them to issue bands or kicks 
the whole vote to kick system is really flawed and is not used that often you can only vote to kick somebody and at that it, it doesn't display their Avatar icon 
but it does display their username if you bothered to read the very small notification text it did display their Avatar icon at some point but they removed it this makes it really difficult to figure out if the vote to kick is in good faith or not so most people just decline it 
and then the bad actor remains 
VRChat could benefit from a permission system so that the host can assign people as moderator and be able to kick people this would get rid of a lot of Bad actors in public lobbies and lobbies hosted by users
that's all that we're asking for is better moderation tools
title: self moderation tools
